steps: New public key is published before first use.
Validators refresh and trust old plus new keys during overlap.
Issuer begins signing new tokens with the new key ID.
Old key retires only after all tokens it signed can no longer be valid.

lesson.scenario: A token issuer rotates an RSA signing key without rejecting tokens signed before the change.

steps.title: Publish the next public key
steps.narration: The issuer creates RSA key k-2026b in the HSM and publishes its public JWK beside active k-2026a.

steps.outcome: Verifiers can learn the next key before tokens use it.
steps.invariant: The new public key is distributed before first use, and the old verification key remains until every token it signed is expired.

steps.title: Warm verifier caches
steps.narration: Orders refreshes immediately; Reports retains k-2026a until its 300-second cache expires.

steps.outcome: At least one verifier confirms propagation.
steps.invariant: The new public key is distributed before first use, and the old verification key remains until every token it signed is expired.

steps.title: Activate the new signer
steps.narration: After the maximum JWKS propagation interval, the issuer signs new token jti=rot-44 with k-2026b.
steps.outcome: New issuance uses the rotated key.
steps.invariant: The new public key is distributed before first use, and the old verification key remains until every token it signed is expired.

steps.title: Keep the old key verifiable
steps.narration: Reports still validates an unexpired k-2026a token while refreshing and then learns k-2026b.
steps.outcome: Rotation causes no outage for old tokens.
steps.invariant: The new public key is distributed before first use, and the old verification key remains until every token it signed is expired.

steps.title: Retire after token expiry
steps.narration: After the last k-2026a token expiry plus clock-skew allowance, the old public key is removed and private material is destroyed.
steps.invariant: The new public key is distributed before first use, and the old verification key remains until every token it signed is expired.
